notes.title: What's New in Version 4.1.2
notes.content:
This update has a few bug fixes and improvements, including:
[list]
[*] Dealing damage with Staff of Ghorummaz no longer prioritizes hero targets to damage.
[*] Using Short Term Solution on a face down card no longer reveals what card it was.
[/list]

notes.title: What's New in Version 4.1.1: Game Recording & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Sentinels now has integration with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/gamerecording] Steam Game Recording[/url] feature, available in the beta version of the Steam Client.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/gamerecording][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807225/d513fa5c82f2251f93761904af4acf9559c51965.jpg[/img]
[/url]

This update has various modernizations to the low level game engine. The minimum supported macOS version is now Mojave 10.14+.

Plus, we're announcing [b]Sentinels of the Multiverse 2[/b], now in crowdfunding on BackerKit! [url=https://sentinelsdigital.com/2]Visit the campaign to learn more and pledge your support.[/url]

[url=https://sentinelsdigital.com/2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7394892/a7c2755e20dd8523860aed367a95bdab888fcd3b.jpg[/img]
[/url]

This update also includes various bug fixes and improvements, including:
[list]
[*] Fixed an interface issue with card play drag & drop when dropping on a card next to another card.
[*] Go to Roost now properly uses "put into play" as is written on the card.
[*] When Your Heart's Desire is destroyed, you may now choose the order in which your cards are destroyed.
[*] Fixed issues with Maximum Speed Johnny Rocket's power when used by other heroes or interacting with deck manipulation effects such as Temporal Keelhaul.
[*] Fixed a problem where it was possible to start a game with Earth-Prime villains in Advanced mode but their Advanced effects were not in play.
[*] Rallying Cry no longer allows choosing the Representative of Earth, since they are not a player.
[*] The end of OblivAeon mode summary screen now shows Star Knight Hashik of Haassaa's incapacitated portrait properly.
[*] Eldritch's Staff of Ghorummaz no longer defaults to adding tokens to Malador’s spells.
[*] Athena Helm and Perfect Disguise now work properly with the villain decks in OblivAeon mode.
[*] The Haunting of Lantern Hill now interacts correctly with Meager Winnings.
[*] Protect And Serve will no longer prevent damage to other heroes if Star Knight is isolated by Miss Information.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 4.1 and Magical Mysteries Mini-Pack Now Available
notes.content:
Bolster the Freedom League with a ghost of the American Revolution and the world's Master Mage. You'll need them to face a sinister adept of the arcane arts and survive a mysterious realm beneath the surface.

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210250/Sentinels_of_EarthPrime__Magical_Mysteries_MiniPack]Magical Mysteries Mini-Pack[/url] is now available as DLC. It includes Eldritch, Lantern Jack, Malador, and Sub-Terra.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210250/Sentinels_of_EarthPrime__Magical_Mysteries_MiniPack

To celebrate, we will be streaming the long-awaited [b]Sentinels of Earth-Prime Listening Party[/b] on [b]October 31 at 2 PM Eastern.[/b] [url=https://twitch.tv/handelabragames]Join Jean-Marc and Jaye on Twitch[/url] to experience the music come to life!

[url=https://twitch.tv/handelabragames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807225/ebe97d1877b257c76988b512022d745b5b31b04b.jpg[/img][/url]

Two variants are included in the Mini-Pack: [b]Chilling Tales Lantern Jack[/b] and [b]Eldritch's Last Stand.[/b] The variants will both become unlockable on [b]October 31[/b] at the end of Handelabra Live ([url=https://twitch.tv/handelabragames]streaming from 7 PM Eastern on Twitch[/url]). Spooky!

[url=https://twitch.tv/handelabragames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807225/7a25bf0e4fd407b94f1e20d8df5752a7a8d88da8.png[/img][/url]

As of today, the Sentinels Digital (Enhanced Edition) journey we began with you in October 2014, nine years ago, is complete! While there may be no further official content released for Sentinels Digital, the game is by no means "dead." We'll have more to talk about later, including:
[list]
[*] Sentinels of Earth-Prime Official Soundtrack
[*] Improved support for Earth-Prime style content in Steam Workshop
[*] Multiplayer Compatibility Pack to allow players without expansions to join games with expansions
[/list]

We also know that a digital version of Sentinels of the Multiverse: Definitive Edition is on the minds of many, and we'll have news about that soon!

This update also includes various bug fixes and improvements, including:
[list]
[*] Increased the speed of fast-forwarding through multiple damages.
[*] The enter keyboard shortcut now works properly again for playing cards and using powers via full card view.
[*] Fixed an issue with Still Life being played out of turn.
[/list]

notes.title: What's New in Version 4.0.3
notes.content:
The Final Forms of the Freedom League are becoming available, one per week!

[url=https://sentinelsdigital.com/variantsearthprime]Visit our website to learn more![/url]

This update also includes various bug fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed some text layout and sizing issues.
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial could get stuck on Captain Thunder's turn.
[*] Fixed a problem interaction between In Medias Res and Grue Meta-Mind.
[*] Fixed a problem interaction between Uh Yeah, I'm That Guy! and Short-Term Solution.
[*] Dominate Will no longer causes incapacitated heroes to deal damage.
[*] Fixed some cards not working properly with Unshackled Resilience.
[*] Fixed an inaccuracy with the logic for Maximum Speed Johnny Rocket's unlock condition.
[/list]

notes.title: Variants are Coming with Version 4.0.2
notes.content:
The Final Forms of the Freedom League are coming soon! This update adds support for 10 hero variants which will become unlockable (one per week) starting May 23.

Starting next week, and each week thereafter, a variant will become unlockable on [url=https://twitch.tv/handelabragames]Handelabra Live[/url] (based on your votes in the survey below). Then the race is on to see who will be the first to discover the variant. Show us on social media that you’ve found the variant to be immortalized in the [url=https://sentinelsdigital.com/halloffame]Hall of Fame![/url]

[url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/SGT9RSX]Visit the survey now[/url] to have your say in which variants become unlockable first!

Here's the full process for how it will work:

[list]
[*] Version 4.0.2 will be required for unlocking variants, so be sure to update!
[*] Each week, on [url=https://twitch.tv/handelabragames]Handelabra Live[/url] (7 pm Eastern on Tuesday) at the end of the stream, the top voted variant will be made available to unlock (restart your game to be sure you see the Variants banner on that hero). The condition is still a secret!
[*] Play the game and try to unlock the variant. The first to show us their unlock screenshot on our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/handelabra]Twitter[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/handelabra]Discord[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/Handelabra]Facebook[/url]) will be awarded a place in the Hall of Fame.
[*] Once the community determines the necessary and sufficient conditions for unlocking the variant (or if approximately 30 days have passed), the Unlock button will be enabled in-game. We will monitor the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1974290/discussions/]Sentinels of Earth-Prime Steam community forum[/url] and our own [url=https://discord.gg/handelabra]Discord server[/url] for the purposes of this step. At this time, the variant will also be made playable in Sentinels of the Multiverse and the official conditions will be posted on the [url=https://sentinelsdigital.com/variants]Variants page[/url].
[/list]

Note that to unlock a variant hero in multiplayer, you must be controlling that hero.

We're excited to get started with the variant hunt for Sentinels of Earth-Prime, and we hope you are too!

This update also includes various bug fixes and improvements, including:
[list]
[*] Improved the visual clarity of text on lower resolution screens.
[*] The Temptation of Orpheus makes it more clear what card would be put into play if you don't take damage.
[/list]

notes.title: What's New in Version 4.0.1
notes.content:
This update includes various bug fixes and improvements.
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where the Continue Game button would not always appear properly.
[*] Fixed a problem where selecting Sky-Scraper variants could show blank cards.
[*] Improved text formatting on Crater Ape.
[*] Fixed various graphical issues in multiplayer.
[*] Improved the visual clarity of card text on some screen sizes.
[*] Fixed an issue where Controlled Demolition did not work with Nihilor Coilbound.
[*] Nihilor Soul Furnace no longer triggers on non-target environment cards being destroyed.
[*] Fixed a freeze that could occur with The Inevitable Result.
[*] Fixed a freeze that could occur if Lady Lunar was destroyed while dealing damage.
[*] Farside Manufactory now properly draws cards if the auto-draw option is turned off.
[*] Fixed a problem interaction between Advanced Argo and Imbued Vitality.
[*] Star Knight's incapacitated ability no longer allows selection of out of play Locations.
[*] Freedom's Touch card draw is now non-optional as written.
[*] Improved informational text on various cards.
[*] Challenge mode Spite: Agent of Gloom is now playable in Earth-Prime.
[*] Fixed a visual glitch where multiple images of Meta-Mind could appear after flipping.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of Omega's alternate ending.
[/list]

notes.title: Sentinels of Earth-Prime Launch Date: April 11
notes.content:
Get ready to visit the Omniverse! Sentinels of Earth-Prime will be launching worldwide on Steam, iOS, and Google Play on [b]Tuesday, April 11th, 2023.[/b]

[b]Sentinels of Earth-Prime[/b] is a cooperative card game that recreates the pulse-pounding action of superhero comics. Play as a team of heroes, using the rules of [b]Sentinels of the Multiverse[/b] and the combined setting and characters of the critically acclaimed Mutants & Masterminds roleplaying game, to protect Earth-Prime!

Sentinels of Earth-Prime is a standalone game, but it is also fully cross-compatible with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/337150/Sentinels_of_the_Multiverse/]Sentinels of the Multiverse[/url]. If both games are installed on the same computer, you can play with all owned content from within either game.

[url=https://twitch.tv/handelabragames]Join us for a launch party on Twitch on April 11th at 7:00 PM Eastern![/url]

[h3]This digital version includes all content from the SoEP core game:[/h3]
[list]
[*]10 Heroes: Bowman, Captain Thunder, Daedalus, Dr. Metropolis, Johnny Rocket, Lady Liberty, Pseudo, The Raven, Siren, and Star Knight
[*]4 Villains: Argo the Ultimate Android, Hades, Grue Meta-Mind, and Omega
[*]4 Environments: Freedom City, Farside City, Tartarus, and The Terminus
[*]Unlockable Hero variants coming soon!
[/list]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Cross-compatibility with Sentinels of the Multiverse content.
[*]Original music by composer Jean-Marc Giffin, including the official Earth-Prime Theme Song, ambient tracks for each environment, and ending themes for each villain.
[*]Beautifully rendered environment backdrops put you right in the action.
[*]Brand new artwork for every Hero and Villain in the game, created by an all-star team of artists.
[*]Over 9,000 different potential battles to choose from.
[*]Play a solo game with 3 to 5 heroes or pass & play with your friends.
[*]Cross-platform online multiplayer with friends and others from around the world.
[*]Steam Cloud Saves and 13 achievements to unlock.
[/list]
